name: Yard strategy x SHC count
description: Grid study on the short shc-paired-dual-cycle fixture (2 vessels, about 1 sim-hour of work): yard allocation strategy x two or four SHCs, each compared with the fixture as it is (nearest-wtp, three SHCs). warmUpS is 0 on purpose: the default 2 h warm-up would use up the fixture's whole workload before measuring starts.
